name: v2.7 D4 Local PoC and Negative Control
description: Run a minimal local PoC, negative control, and repeatability checks for D3 survivors; preserve files as scan artifacts.
content:
Repository: {{repo_full}} at commit {{commit_sha}}. Scope: {{repo_scope}}. Dependencies: {{dependencies}}. Configuration: {{configuration}}.
Canonical candidate: {{summary}}. Claimed type: {{vulnerability_type}}. Fault: {{file_path}}:{{line}}.
Actor: {{malicious_actor}}. Claimed trigger: {{malicious_input_example}}. Trace: {{trigger_flow}}.
Explanation and root-cause fingerprint: {{explanation}}.
This candidate survived D3. The engine supplies the D3 verdict and evidence above this prompt. Treat it as a hypothesis to test. Work only in the isolated pinned checkout; never send attack traffic to public services, use real secrets, or broadcast a live transaction.
Build the smallest feasible test: unit test, real component harness, integration with local DB/protocol state, then local multi-actor or fork simulation only when necessary. Run the attack and a negative control using the same relevant path with corrected identity/domain/state. Repeat both at least twice to check determinism. Prove the security impact, not just a crash or error text. Write the executable test/harness and actual command output to files INSIDE the repository workspace. Return relative paths for the test, attack output, negative-control output, and repeat output in poc_artifact_paths. Do not claim reproduced unless all files physically exist, attack and negative-control outcomes differ as expected, and repeated runs are consistent. Report exact command, stdout/stderr/exit code, expected/observed results and blockers. A proposed test, a mock of the bug, or a successful build is not a PoC.
Use exactly one poc_status: reproduced, not_reproduced, blocked_missing_dependency, blocked_missing_configuration, unsafe_external_dependency, non_deterministic, invalidated_by_test. Set poc_artifact_dir to an empty string; the engine fills it only after verifying and copying actual files. _reserved_poc may summarize observed evidence, but cannot substitute for the saved artifacts.
